one_month_reasoning: No AT&T earnings in the window (Q4 results late January; next ex-dividend early January). Scheduled: Verizon Q3 on 2026-10-26 (source 19), T-Mobile Q3 around 2026-10-28, Comcast and Charter late October. Read-across: Verizon has been adding consumer phones again (184k in Q2) and cable keeps adding 400k+ mobile lines a quarter, so a strong VZ print with aggressive pricing would weigh on AT&T; T-Mobile no longer reports phone net adds. The unscheduled driver is SpaceX news: the stock fell 10.8% on 2026-10-09 (SpaceX buys Grain 800 MHz spectrum, says it will be a major US carrier) and 8.0% on 2026-10-23 (Bloomberg: talks for 80,000+ cell sites). Further headlines (FCC approval of the Grain licenses, a tower master lease) are plausible inside a month and skew down; a carrier-satellite wholesale deal or analyst pushback would skew up. After a ~16% drop in two weeks some mean reversion is common but momentum after news shocks often persists, so we centre at $21.0 (≈ +0.3%) with a 9.5% monthly s.d. (slightly above the 30%/3.5 = 8.6% rule for the elevated headline risk).

bear.story: Starlink Mobile signs tower and roaming deals and prices aggressively from late 2027; Verizon and cable keep promotions high; wireless ARPU flat from 2027, fiber ARPU -4%/yr; EV/EBITDA de-rates to ~5.25x, P/E ~7x.

base.story: Guidance broadly met (FY26 adj EPS ~$2.40, FY27 FCF ~$19B) but FY28 EBITDA growth ~3.5% (below the 5%+ target) as wireless pricing fades and Legacy turns EBITDA-negative; Starlink overhang keeps the multiple at ~6x EBITDA / 8x EPS.

bull.story: SpaceX ends up wholesaling via the carriers or slips beyond 2028; AT&T price rises stick; fiber JV and Mexico proceeds bring leverage toward 2.5x early; multiple recovers to ~6.75x / 9x.

comps_summary.peer_range: Fwd P/E 2.5x (CHTR, distorted) / 6.3x-23.7x; 2027E EV/EBITDA 3.99x (TEF) - 7.41x (SCMN). US four: P/E 6.3-11.9x (median 8.7x ex-CHTR), EV/EBITDA 4.38-6.17x (median 5.39x).
comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: 6.0x NTM EBITDA on our EV (incl. $18.0B NCI preferred interests and $2.95B preferred) is ~5.5x on the peers MarketScreener basis: just above the US median 5.39x, below the 11-peer median 5.98x and T today (5.78x / ~6.3x). 8.0x P/E is below the US median 8.7x and T today 8.3x.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: No premium. AT&T has the strongest converged fiber + wireless position (42.8% of AHI households converged, record 769k internet adds in Q3) and the lowest churn, which argues for a premium to cable, but leverage rose to 3.13x after EchoStar, Legacy EBITDA turns negative after 2027, and a well-funded entrant (SpaceX) starts service at the horizon. The European/Canadian EBITDA multiples are IFRS 16 (lease costs below EBITDA), which flatters their EV/EBITDA vs US GAAP; we lean on the US set.

thesis_break_reason: $16 (-24%) is ~5.6x our-basis EV/2027E EBITDA and an ~18% FCF yield on the $19B floor: a level consistent only with the market pricing a cut to the FCF outlook or dividend, i.e. a wireless price war (Starlink plus Verizon) breaking the ARPU driver, or financing stress (leverage stuck above 3x with buybacks halted). Ordinary 30% volatility around a $22 value rarely reaches it without such news.

Durability of the +4% postpaid phone ARPU from rate-plan refresh and legacy-plan price rises against Verizon's turnaround and cable MVNO growth.
Fiber ARPU erosion (-4% y/y) vs penetration gains in Lumen territories; cable ("irrational" $30-40 gig pricing per Comcast) response.
Size and timing of fiber JV proceeds; leverage path to 2.5x now "during 2029".
Legacy EBITDA turning negative after 2027 and the pace of copper cost removal; copper monetisation upside.

reasoning: Industry lane. (1) Facts: Q3-26 adjusted EPS $0.65 (GAAP $0.13 after a $2.6B non-cash Mexico held-for-sale impairment, ~$0.8B separation charge), revenue +5.3%, AC service +6.1%, postpaid phone ARPU +4%, 379k phone adds, 769k internet adds; FY26 EPS raised to ~$2.40; FY27 FCF $19B+, capex cut to $22-23B; net debt 3.13x after the $22.65B EchoStar spectrum. (2) Price action from primary/industry sources: 10-09 -10.8% = SpaceX buys Grain 800 MHz spectrum (~$8B) and says it will be a major US carrier (all three carriers -9% to -13%, towers +6-13%); 10-21 -6.4% = results day despite beat-and-raise (slower phone adds, fiber ARPU -4%, higher interest/working capital); 10-23 -8.0% = Bloomberg report of SpaceX talks for 80k+ sites. None changes FY26-27 earnings; they change the multiple (and our FY28 driver path modestly). (3) Industry read: SpaceX says service starts end-2027 (65 MHz EchoStar spectrum), analysts split (Wolfe "years", TD Cowen "highly bearish"), Bernstein sizes a terrestrial build at $50-130B; Verizon consumer adds have turned positive, cable adds 400k+ lines/quarter and complains of "irrational" fiber pricing; FCC copper order speeds Legacy exit. (4) Model: six-driver build gives FY27/28 EBITDA 49.3B/50.8B (consensus 49.75B/51.99B), EPS $2.57/$2.86 (Zacks $2.54/$2.86), FCF $19.0B/$20.5B (guide $19B+/$21B+); research target (12m) $22.31 from EV/EBITDA, P/E and FCF yield legs inside peer ranges. Custom legs: none (all legs from the set; segment margins are judgment, not driver-linked). (5) Distribution: scenario mix bear $16.1 / base $22.3 / bull $28.1 at 25/50/25 with 16% within-scenario vol, nudged to a $21.8 median for headline risk; ~28% total vol vs 30% realised. P(>=21) 0.555, P(>=16.74) 0.82, P(>=28) 0.15. Research limits: Bigdata.com, Alpha Vantage and Twelve Data quotas were exhausted, so consensus came from MarketScreener and Nasdaq/Zacks pages; a Polymarket market on a SpaceX phone plan was found only via a secondary page and not used.

base.story: Guidance broadly met (FY26 adj EPS ~$2.40, FY27 FCF ~$19B) but FY28 EBITDA growth ~3.5% (below the 5%+ target) as wireless pricing fades and Legacy turns EBITDA-negative; Starlink overhang keeps the multiple at ~6x EBITDA / 8x EPS.

bull.story: SpaceX ends up wholesaling via the carriers or slips beyond 2028; AT&T price rises stick; fiber JV and Mexico proceeds bring leverage toward 2.5x early; multiple recovers to ~6.75x / 9x.

model_inputs.structure_note: Driver-led telecom build: 6 drivers (postpaid phones, wireless service ARPU, advanced home internet connections, AHI ARPU, Legacy revenue, capital investment) compute 86.0% of FY2025 revenue (wireless service 67,384 + equipment 22,826 + AHI 9,410 + Legacy 8,472 of 125,648; base residual ~0%). Business fiber/transitional, Latin America (sold Q1 2027) and Corporate are plain segments. Segment margins are judgment from the reported AC EBITDA path less D&A (not driver-linked); capex = capital_investment driver. Value is carried by NTM EV/EBITDA (0.5), P/E on stated NTM adjusted EPS (0.35) and FCF yield (0.15); no DCF (policy). EBIT is recurring GAAP after SBC, excluding one-offs (Mexico impairment, separation charges).
model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) fiber JV proceeds are undisclosed, we assume ~$2B at 85% in net debt; (2) EV includes $18.0B subsidiary preferred interests (NCI) and $2.95B preferred stock, which peers mostly lack, so our 6.0x equals ~5.5x on the MarketScreener basis; (3) the P/E and FCF legs use stated per-share figures because the engine model earnings omit ~$1.5B pension/other income and ~$1.5B NCI. Engine base horizon value 22.31 = fair_value.value.
